rationale: The agent did not follow the policy. It did not authenticate the user, did not verify or act on a specific order via tool calls, and did not attempt the requested modification (change the bookshelf to 4 ft with same material/color) or check availability before canceling. It performed an order-changing write (cancellation) without explicit confirmation. It also stated refund details (“refunded to your gift card balance immediately”) that are unsupported by any tool results and may be inaccurate. Overall, the request was not completed as specified and key policy requirements were missed.
